name: Death Druid
summary: Some druids believe that birth and death are the most important parts of the natural cycle.
replacesText: Nature Bond; Wild Shape; Resist Nature's Lure; Venom Immunity

features.name: Etheric Tether
features.summary: The manifested phantom must remain within 50 feet. Beyond that distance it takes damage, and at the end of the turn it is forced back into the death druid's consciousness if still outside the tether.

features.name: Phantom
features.summary: Choose the phantom's emotional focus. The phantom advances using the death druid's Druid level as its Spiritualist level.

features.name: Soul Magic
features.summary: A death druid adds the following spells to her druid spell list at the given spell levels: 0— grave wordsOA ; 1st— sanctify corpseUM ; 2nd— calm spiritOA, false life, ghostbane dirgeAPG, spiritual weapon ; 3rd— speak with dead ; 4th— speak with hauntACG, spiritual allyAPG ; 5th— breath of life, call spiritOA, mass ghostbane dirgeAPG ; 6th— circle of death, undeath to death. This ability replaces nature sense and wild empathy.

features.name: Bonded Manifestation
features.summary: Manifest the phantom partially through the death druid for 3 plus Druid level rounds per day. The rounds need not be consecutive.

features.name: Resist Death's Call (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, a death druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against death effects, negative energy, and energy drain. This ability replaces resist nature’s lure.

features.name: Negative Immunity (Su)
features.summary: At 9th level, a death druid is immune to negative energy and energy drain. This ability replaces venom immunity.

features.name: Spiritual Bond
features.summary: When damage would reduce the death druid below 0 hit points, the phantom can sacrifice hit points to prevent an equal amount of that damage while manifested in ectoplasmic form or within the death druid's consciousness.

mechanicalNotes: Phantom emotional focus, full level-scaled companion statistics, Etheric Tether, Bonded Manifestation rounds, and Spiritual Bond rules are automated.

companionGrants.label: phantom
rules: The phantom can manifest fully in ectoplasmic or incorporeal form after a 1-minute ritual.
Etheric Tether limits the manifested phantom to 50 feet from the death druid.
The phantom cannot manifest while an eidolon or shadow companion belonging to the death druid is manifested.
When the phantom's unfinished business is resolved, a replacement phantom arrives during the next week.
